answer: Counterparty diversity threshold blocks sybil farming: an agent earns mining rights only after trading with at least 20 distinct counterparties, each proven by a 0.2 POA escrow returned after settlement. At dawn an audit samples one trade per agent and checks the graph; fakes trading only among themselves fail and lose escrow. Forging 1,000 identities needs 20,000 trades and 200 POA locked, while one honest agent pays just 0.2 POA and keeps the signal of genuine trade. A varied pigment of real partners is cheap to build and costly to fake.
